mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analytics.search_event(id,dmnd_id,srch_cn_exst_yn,nrmlz_srch_cnd_cn,rslt_cnt,req_ms_cnt) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS uuid),#{requestId},#{hasQuery},CAST(#{filters} AS jsonb),#{count},#{duration})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS search_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE rslt_cnt=0) AS zero_result_count, coalesce(sum(rslt_cnt),0)::bigint AS result_count_sum,coalesce(sum(req_ms_cnt),0)::bigint AS duration_ms_sum FROM analytics.search_event

SELECT id::text,inst_id::text AS organization_id,dtset_rvsn_id::text AS dataset_revision_id,type_cd AS kind,engn_ver_nm AS engine_version,rqstr_id::text AS requested_by,bgng_dt AS started_at,end_dt AS finished_at,stts_cd AS status,data_artcl_cnt AS field_count,sou_hash_vl AS source_hash,err_cd AS error_code FROM analytics.analysis_run ORDER BY bgng_dt DESC,id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) AS run_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE stts_cd='SUCCEEDED') AS succeeded_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE stts_cd='FAILED') AS failed_count, coalesce(sum(data_artcl_cnt),0)::bigint AS field_count_sum,coalesce(sum(jsonb_array_length(bss_cn)),0)::bigint AS evidence_count FROM analytics.analysis_run

SELECT id::text,inst_id::text AS organization_id,dtset_rvsn_id::text AS dataset_revision_id,type_cd AS kind,engn_ver_nm AS engine_version,rqstr_id::text AS requested_by,bgng_dt AS started_at,end_dt AS finished_at,stts_cd AS status,data_artcl_cnt AS field_count,sou_hash_vl AS source_hash,err_cd AS error_code FROM analytics.analysis_run WHERE id=CAST(#{value} AS uuid)
SELECT bss_cn::text AS evidence FROM analytics.analysis_run WHERE id=CAST(#{value} AS uuid)
